body:
**Problem:** `add_ocean_diagnostics!` passed one `FieldStatus` to SST, SSS, and SSH variances. Since `compute_at!` skips a field whose status already holds that time, whichever is fetched first is computed and the other two are skipped. I noticed this when I got constant SST² and SSS² diagnostics.

**Solution:** have `computed_field_status` now return a new `FieldStatus(clock_time)` for each field.
title: Give each ocean surface output its own `FieldStatus`
